Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using Flag-tagged peroxiredoxins to identify interactors. While the study focuses on cysteine-dependent (disulfide) interactions, the MS analysis itself was a standard bottom-up DDA LFQ approach following on-bead digestion. The 'cysteine-dependency' was achieved via sample preparation (NEM/IA quenching and mutant comparisons) rather than a PTM-specific enrichment ontology like phospho or glyco.
